WITH UserStats AS ( SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.name AS userName, COUNT(a.attempt_id) AS totalAttempts, SUM(a.is_correct) AS correctAnswers, SUM(CASE WHEN p.difficulty = 'EASY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS easyCount, SUM(CASE WHEN p.difficulty = 'MEDIUM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mediumCount, SUM(CASE WHEN p.difficulty = 'HARD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hardCount, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN p.difficulty = 'HARD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN p.difficulty = 'MEDIUM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AND SUM(CASE WHEN p.difficulty = 'HARD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN p.difficulty = 'EASY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'HARD' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN p.difficulty = 'MEDIUM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN p.difficulty = 'EASY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'EASY' END AS difficulty FROM tbl_users u JOIN tbl_attempt_sessions s ON u.user_id = s.user_id JOIN tbl_attempt_details a ON s.session_id = a.session_id JOIN tbl_problems p ON a.problem_id = p.problem_id GROUP BY u.user_id, u.name )
SELECT * FROM UserStats ORDER BY (correctAnswers * 10 + totalAttempts * 0.5 + CASE WHEN difficulty = 'HARD' THEN 5 WHEN difficulty = 'MEDIUM' THEN 3 ELSE 1 END) DESC, (CASE WHEN totalAttempts = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(correctAnswers AS FLOAT) / totalAttempts * 100 END) DESC, totalAttempts DESC LIMIT 20;
